hero.heading: Air Freight Kenya | JKIA & Moi Airport Cargo Clearance
hero.lead: Kenya Tradex supports air cargo movements through Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) in Nairobi and Moi International Airport (MBA) in Mombasa for businesses that need faster shipment planning than ocean freight can provide. Air freight is commonly used for urgent cargo, higher-value goods, time-sensitive commercial shipments and products that require shorter transit windows. We partner with major international airlines including Emirates, Qatar Airways, Ethiopian Airlines, Kenya Airways, and Cargolux for competitive rates and reliable schedules.

blocks.title: International air freight for urgent and time-sensitive cargo
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex supports air cargo movements through Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) in Nairobi and Moi International Airport (MBA) in Mombasa for businesses that need faster shipment planning than ocean freight can provide. Air freight is commonly used for urgent cargo, higher-value goods, time-sensitive commercial shipments and products that require shorter transit windows. We partner with major international airlines including Emirates, Qatar Airways, Ethiopian Airlines, Kenya Airways, and Cargolux for competitive rates and reliable schedules.
items: International air freight: Support for airport-to-airport and onward delivery cargo movements through JKIA Nairobi and MBA Mombasa.
Urgent cargo planning (24-48hr delivery): Practical support for shipments that need faster movement and tighter timing.
Customs coordination: Documentation and cargo processing support linked to export and import requirements.
Door-to-door support: Delivery planning for cargo moving beyond the airport arrival point.
Temperature-controlled (Reefer) cargo: For pharmaceuticals, perishables, and fresh produce.
Dangerous goods (DG) handling: Certified for hazardous materials with proper documentation.
Real-time shipment tracking: Full visibility from pickup to delivery.

blocks.title: Air freight transit times from Kenya
blocks.body: *Transit times are estimates and depend on flight schedules, customs processing, and destination airport. Contact us for exact timelines for your specific shipment.

blocks.title: Moi International Airport cargo support in Mombasa
blocks.body: For cargo moving through Moi International Airport (MBA) , Kenya Tradex supports importers and exporters who need practical cargo clearance, air freight documentation and onward delivery planning. Kenya Tradex is not the airport operator, but we can help with the freight and customs steps around a commercial shipment.
items: Airport cargo guidance: We help clients understand what cargo details, Airway Bill information and consignee documents are needed before asking for release support.
Mombasa air freight support: Useful for urgent imports, samples, spare parts, perishables and commercial shipments entering through MBA.

Transparent contact intent: If you need Kenya Tradex cargo clearance help, use the quote form or WhatsApp link on this page. If you need the airport authority directly, confirm the official contact through the airport operator.

blocks.title: Air freight destinations supported from Kenya
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex supports air cargo coordination for shipments moving through JKIA Nairobi and MBA Mombasa into regional and international markets:
items: Middle East: Dubai (DXB), Abu Dhabi (AUH), Doha (DOH), Jeddah (JED)
Asia: China (Guangzhou - CAN, Shanghai - PVG, Beijing - PEK), India (Mumbai - BOM, Delhi - DEL), Singapore (SIN)
Europe: United Kingdom (London - LHR), Germany (Frankfurt - FRA), Netherlands (Amsterdam - AMS), Belgium (Brussels - BRU)
North America: United States (New York - JFK, Atlanta - ATL, Chicago - ORD)
Africa: South Africa (Johannesburg - JNB), Nigeria (Lagos - LOS), Ghana (Accra - ACC)

blocks.title: Commodities commonly moved by air
items: Fresh produce and flowers: Kenyan avocados, vegetables, roses to Europe & Middle East — temperature-controlled available.
Pharmaceutical and healthcare cargo: Temperature-controlled medicines, vaccines, and medical supplies.
Electronics and higher-value goods: Cargo needing faster transit and closer handling.
Industrial parts and components: Air freight can help when replacement or production parts are time-sensitive.
Textiles & Apparel: Fashion and fabric exports to global markets.

blocks.title: How the air freight process works
items: Step 1: Request a quote with cargo details, dimensions, weight, origin and destination.
Step 2: We book space with airline and provide flight schedule.
Step 3: Airway bill preparation and customs clearance coordination.
Step 4: Real-time tracking during transit.
Step 5: Door-to-door delivery at destination.

blocks.title: Air freight questions
items:
How fast is air freight from Nairobi to Dubai? 
Air freight from Nairobi (JKIA) to Dubai (DXB) typically takes 24-48 hours including customs clearance. Kenya Tradex handles the entire process for fast delivery.

What airports do you ship from in Kenya? 
We operate from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) in Nairobi and Moi International Airport (MBA) in Mombasa, with connections to all major international destinations.

What types of cargo can be shipped via air freight? 
We handle time-sensitive goods, pharmaceuticals, perishables, electronics, documents, samples, and high-value cargo. Temperature-controlled and dangerous goods options are available.

Which airlines do you partner with for air freight? 
Kenya Tradex partners with major international airlines including Emirates, Qatar Airways, Ethiopian Airlines, Kenya Airways, and Cargolux for competitive rates and reliable schedules.

How do I get an air freight quote from Kenya? 
Contact Kenya Tradex with your cargo details including type, weight, dimensions, origin (Nairobi JKIA or Mombasa MBA), destination, and timeline. We provide competitive air freight rates within hours.
